column1: # Source of every icon in `ArecaIcons`; `./gradlew :standalone:icons:generateIcons` reads it.
# Columns: name, set (lucide | tabler | manual), source id, comma-separated flags.
# Flags: mirror (autoMirror in right-to-left layouts), filled (the outline is also filled),
#   same-as=<Name> (deliberate duplicate of another name's drawing, kept as an alias).
# `manual` icons are maintained by hand and are not regenerated.
